questions: Is the pain located in your face or head?
orders: Palpation of the temporomandibular joint and masseter muscles
Inspection of the oral cavity for dental caries, abscesses, or recent extractions
Neurological examination of cranial nerves V and VII, including facial sensation and corneal reflex

results: 1. Palpation of the temporomandibular joint and masseter muscles
2. Inspection of the oral cavity for dental caries, abscesses, or recent extractions
3. Neurological examination of cranial nerves V and VII, including facial sensation and corneal reflex
cranial nerve examination: involuntary blepharospasm with perioral and jaw dystonic spasms, provoked by speech and eating; otherwise normal
4. Trigger point testing for paroxysmal pain episodes
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Oromandibular dystonia (Meige syndrome)
Alternatives:
1. Temporomandibular joint disorder
2. Hemifacial spasm
3. Dental pathology
